item.tib: ma cig bka' gsang dbang gi lha mo'i gtor bskul
item.coloph: ma cig bka' gsang lha mo'i gtor bskul/ 'chi med yum sras gshen gsum gyis lung bstan/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i phyag len/ stag la me 'bar gyis gtan la phab nas/ lha klu mi gsum snang mdog dang bzhi la gdams pa'o/ rim par brgyud nas bla chen dran pa nam mkhas stong chen dmu gyer med la bka' yi gnyer gtad nas/ des sprul sku blo ldan snying po la brgyud pa'o/ dge legs dar rgyas 'phel gnas shog/
